scope: Standalone generic Boolean matrix construction, at most 12 variables. No production solver integration, external inputs, curves, targets, scalar recovery, relation collection or rho runs.
mathematical_boundary: A fixed support envelope E_j represents p_j(c)=sum_{m in E_j} c_{j,m} x^m over F2. Coefficients may change. Compile a parity mask per product monomial and multiplier. At application recompute actual generator degrees, select all degree-eligible multipliers, evaluate parity, remove zero rows and compact actual output columns. Exact-support caching cannot reuse changed inputs; this different contract can.
envelope: Each ordered base generator support union constant and all n linear monomials. Declared using only the base fixture, before generating assignments. Exact n, degree, active mask and generator-count guard; each actual support must be a subset of its ordered envelope.
candidate: For each possible multiplier t compile groups (m OR t, XOR coefficient-slot mask), retaining only source monomials with degree <= D-degree(t). Compile multipliers through D-min_degree(E_j). On every apply derive actual coefficient bits and generator degree d, visit all multipliers of degree <= D-d, evaluate parity, remove empty rows and recompact output support. On context mismatch or support escape use direct construction and retain the original envelope. Exceeding a compilation limit is an explicit refusal, not a zero/UNSAT matrix.

families_contract.repeat: Repeat the base instance. Matrix-copy control remains relevant.
families_contract.coefficients: First instance is base. Subsequent distinct deterministic coefficient assignments sample all generator envelopes; force a quadratic term in each generator.
families_contract.degree_cycle: As coefficients, but first generator cycles quadratic/linear/constant/zero; the others remain quadratic. Newly required multipliers are counted before cancellation.
families_contract.escape: As coefficients, but every fourth assignment adds the cubic monomial 7 outside the envelope and must fall back.

controls.direct: Build products, parity, compact columns, and packed rows anew.
controls.layout: Rebuild products and reuse columns only on exact actual output-support equality.
controls.schedule: Replay precomputed column indices only if the canonical input equals the base.
controls.matrix_cache: Clone the completed matrix only if the canonical input equals the base.

accounting: One cache/schedule compilation per cold batch, every application and fallback, output allocation and validation, output and cache destruction. Input/envelope generation and independent references are common setup outside total_ns; fresh-process receipts include them. Rotate the five arms over ten repetitions; retain all samples. No adaptive cache insertion.
memory: Retained structure bytes use actual Rust Vec capacities, excluding allocator metadata, separately from output payload and whole-worker peak RSS. Compilation may use temporary allocations; peak RSS includes all arms and reference matrices, so it is not candidate-specific peak memory. Compilation group/row limits bound temporary growth; retained byte limit checked on the completed plan.
correctness: Every matrix equals an independent set-parity oracle. Exhaustively vary all 256 coefficient assignments over n=3, four matrix degrees, and eight active-variable masks (8192 cases). Test bit slot 31, degree drops, parity collisions, caps, invalid inputs and support escape.
performance_gate: For each of four n values and batches 16 and 64, on each of coefficients and degree_cycle holdouts, the 95 percent paired bootstrap lower bound for control total_ns / envelope total_ns must exceed 1.05 against direct, layout and matrix_cache separately (48 gates). Repeat/escape and exact schedule remain reported controls. Reject promotion if any gate fails; do not tune from these holdouts.
cross_instance_gate: Every changed in-envelope input must hit and equal the oracle; outside-envelope inputs must fall back and equal the oracle. Exact-support controls must have zero changed hits. Degree-cycle fixtures must contain newly required multipliers.
classification: Mathematical construction diagnostic and bounded engineering experiment. No relation-yield, end-to-end IC, asymptotic, exponent or rho claim. Full pipeline and normalized costs remain null.
